name: Ironstone Camp
summary: At Ironstone Camp, Horde fighters now face the silithid swarm at Rustmaul Digsite. They came to drive out Alliance dwarven excavators, but the attack has changed their purpose.

sections.title: A Change of Mission
sections.body:
Ironstone Camp stands where Thousand Needles meets the western edge of the Shimmering Flats. Moktar Krin led the Horde fighters sent to drive Alliance dwarven excavators from nearby Rustmaul Digsite.

Then silithid burst from a cavern and overran the dig. They attacked both sides, so the surviving defenders now fight the swarm before it spreads across the region.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Ironstone Camp?
faq.answer: The Horde established Ironstone Camp to drive Alliance dwarven excavators from Rustmaul Digsite. After silithid burst from a nearby cavern and overran the dig, its fighters turned to containing the swarm.

faq.q: Who leads the forces at Ironstone Camp?
faq.answer: Moktar Krin leads the Horde fighters at Ironstone Camp. With silithid overrunning the digsite, he directs the defense against the swarm.
Ironstone Camp stands in Thousand Needles, on the western edge of the Shimmering Flats. It lies near the path from the canyon floor to the salt flats.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can stop at the camp before crossing the open salt flats. Its commanders are fighting the silithid swarm threatening their position.
As an Alliance explorer, keep clear of Ironstone Camp. The Horde established it to drive dwarven excavators from Rustmaul Digsite.
